title: NetherCoords
description: Fast Overworld ↔ Nether coordinate converter with automatic Russian/English localization.
body:
# NetherCoords

Instant Overworld ↔ Nether coordinate converter — no calculator needed!

### Features
- `/nc o <x> [y] <z>` → converts Overworld coordinates to Nether (÷8)  
- `/nc n <x> [y] <z>` → converts Nether coordinates to Overworld (×8)  
- Automatically switches messages between **English** and **Russian** based on your client language  
- Optional Y coordinate (defaults to 64)  
- Tab completion for `o` and `n`   

### Examples
/nc o 2400 70 -800   →  Nether: X: 300 Y: 70 Z: -100

/nc n -50 64 120     →  Overworld: X: -400 Y: 64 Z: 960

Perfect for survival, hardcore, speedrunning, or big servers.  
Just drop the jar into your plugins folder and you're ready to go!

Supported versions: **Paper 1.21 – 1.21.10**
